harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: LDAP is operational on node1 for dc=branch,dc=test. Node2 finds alex and sam with unchanged identities and mail addresses. Authenticated administration works, anonymous writes fail, and both nodes retained functionality across sequential reboots without changing the OS release or kernel.
actions_performed: Installed 389 Directory Server on node1 and LDAP client tools on both nodes.
Created and enabled the branch directory instance and imported the staged LDIF.
Allowed read/search access to the people subtree while retaining authenticated write controls.
Verified anonymous writes fail with LDAP error 50 and create no entry.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirming changed boot identities and full recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: LDAP directory and supplied identities imported unchanged
evidence.summary: Shows the original staged LDIF, active/enabled LDAP service, and persisted alex/sam entries with their original names and mail addresses.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can search the people subtree and find both users
evidence.summary: Direct node2 searches return exactly two users—alex and sam—before and after reboots.

evidence.requirement: Updates require authenticated administration and anonymous writes fail
evidence.summary: Authenticated Directory Manager imported the data; anonymous add attempts return insufficient access (50) and leave zero probe entries.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain AlmaLinux 9.6 and boot the original 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.x86_64 kernel.

evidence.requirement: Node1 mandatory restart and LDAP recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID c207ab79-d913-4af0-b630-8f0104ee3ccd, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID 6be76cc9-124a-40ab-afd4-cf629e6e87aa, recovered service/listener/data, and successful node2 search.

evidence.requirement: Node2 mandatory restart and client/data-access recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID a0d04bc6-5f90-4c7b-8283-51dd6932056f, acknowledged reboot, changed boot ID 96c20bb7-d40d-448d-93b3-bdc1f2cf3dbf, restored LDAP client operation, successful two-user search, and preserved write controls.
